influences.name: Itzhak Pearlman
influences.context: Do they actually know that Itzhak Pearlman is a fantastic violinist or are they just sold that quantity?

influences.name: Leonard Slatkin
influences.context: Leonard Slatkin is very unusual in that respect. He really has very definite opinions about what he likes in new music and what he doesn't like.

influences.name: Louise Talma
influences.context: I know Louise and Miriam very well and I've done a lot of their music for the simple reason that they're talented composers and that they needed encouragement.

influences.name: Miriam Gideon
influences.context: I know Louise and Miriam very well and I've done a lot of their music for the simple reason that they're talented composers and that they needed encouragement.

influences.name: Aaron Copland
influences.context: I'm a great admirer of Copland. I wrote Fanfare for the Uncommon Woman, which is a takeoff on his Fanfare for the Common Man.

influences.name: Steve Reich
influences.context: I was just wondering how it started because Steve Reich did the same thing, only his group started in school.

influences.name: Bach
influences.context: I think Bach would just flip if he could hear what we've been doing with his music...I think the piano is perfect for him. It's just perfect.

influences.name: Chopin
influences.context: Chopin, if you took his piano music and played it on any other instrument, would die immediately because the music is written only for the piano.

influences.name: Berlioz
influences.context: You can't reduce Berlioz's orchestrations to the piano. It just dies immediately because the action is so located in the color of the orchestra.
